item.description: BroadwayWorld recently stopped by rehearsals for Manhattan Concert Productions upcoming Broadway Series presentation of JANE EYRE. item.title: Video: Watch Jessica Vosk & Kelli Barrett Sing New BEACHCES Songs
item.description: Jessica Vosk and Kelli Barrett gave a first listen to Beaches the Musical at a recent event at So & So's. The performance included the recently released duet "Wish I Could Be Like You," as well as "Words I Could Have Said" and "Real Woman." Tickets are now on sale for the Broadway production of Beaches, A New Musical, set to begin previews on Friday, March 27, ahead of an official Opening Night on Wednesday, April 22, at the Majestic Theatre (245 W. 44th Street). item.title: Broadway Cast of RAGTIME Set for Monday Performance on THE VIEW
item.description: On Presidents Day, the cast of Broadway's Ragtime will take the stage on The View for a special performance from the hit revival. item.description: It's never too early to put on your trusty Sasquatch costume for an appearance on national television.
